external_collaboration.evidence_quote: On day 1 of arriving in Colleferro we were met with the most wonderful, warm welcome from the staff, students and the principal at 'Leonardo Da Vinci Middle School'. The children waved Irish and Italian flags and the words of Amhrán na bhFiann echoed through the yard! It was the most fabulous sight to behold.

On Day 2 of our school visits, we went to 'G.P. Delfino Primary School'. Again, we received an warm welcome and went on a tour of the school. The children took part in a Q& A session with the students and it was very interesting to hear the differences and similarities between Italian and Irish schools.

Ms. Healy, Ms. McKenna, and Ms. Walsh recently traveled to Kirkkonummi, Finland, to visit a local Montessori school. It was a fantastic opportunity to see Finnish education in action, specifically focusing on outdoor learning. The teachers joined the children for a walk through the local forest, observing how nature and play help students grow. We are excited to bring these fresh ideas back to our own classrooms! ​

​In December 2025, Ms. Gallagher, Ms. White and Ms. Byrne accompanied six 6th class children on a visit to a school in Olhão, Portugal. The children spent 2 days visiting the school, where they experienced school life in Portugal and got to compare the difference to their experiences here in Ireland. Our free time was spent exploring the beautiful sights of Olhão, as well as the nearby Faro and Culatra Island. Christmas in the sun was fun!

Ms T Reilly and Ms Davey visited a school outside Toledo in Spain in November. The school was very welcoming and accommodating in providing a wonderful experience for us. We observed many lessons involving the use of digital devices, STEAM, PE and Robotics. The school has started the CARMEN Project allowing all children in Grade 4, 5 and 6 to download their textbooks on their tablets. This was interesting to see in action.

On October 14th and 15th, St. Ronan's welcomed 22 students and 6 teachers from a school in Colleferro, Italy. Last May a group of 6 students and teachers from our school visited their school and had a wonderful time so we were delighted to host them all, and the show them what St. Ronan's, Clondalkin and Dublin have to offer!

6 children and 4 staff members from St. Ronan's tool part in an Erasmus trip to Rome, Italy. During this time, they visited 2 schools in Colleferro, Italy and took in some excellent site seeing adventures.
